note: Per-provider pages are fetched from /docs/channels-dvr-server/tv-everywhere/providers/<id>/. All providers share the same catalog of ~43 tracked national TVE networks; a network is considered 'available' for a provider when getchannels lists a live sign-in URL for it. This reflects that the network's Adobe Pass integration lists the provider as a participating MVPD, NOT that any specific account/plan is actually entitled -- e.g. getchannels lists AMC/BBC America/IFC/WE tv as available via YouTubeTV, but a real YouTubeTV account tested live against FastChannels' amcn_tve scraper on 2026-08-18 got a clean Adobe Pass deny for all four ('Adobe did not authorize <X> for YouTubeTV'). Treat this data as 'worth trying', not 'confirmed working'.
